faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MDU Rohtak Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Lecturer (Lecture Basis) posts at Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for MDU Rohtak Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the concerned subject to be eligible for the Lecturer (Lecture Basis) positions at MDU Rohtak.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Lecturer (Lecture Basis) positions, with one vacancy each in Computer Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Electrical Engineering at UIET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for MDU Rohtak Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the MDU Rohtak Lecturer (Lecture Basis) recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The salary is paid on an hourly basis: Rs. 600/- per hour for theory and Rs. 300/- per hour for practical, with a maximum limit of Rs. 26,400/- per month or Rs. 75,000/- per semester.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MDU Rohtak Lecturer (Lecture Basis) posts is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MDU Rohtak Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions is based on empanelment.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak. Links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job for the post of Lecturer (Lecture Basis) at MDU Rohtak.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak, Haryana.
